title: Bugs are everywhere and not corrected
body:
-There are a lot of glitches (for example the sync to SleepCycle app is down for months).
-Even if there is the option to send a bug report on the app : it’s not working.
-Sometimes, an offer to the premium subscription appears. You have to be extra vigilant, because when you claim the offer, it goes to the subscription, but make you paye the regular full price !

title: La formule gratuite est insuffisante

title: Nice
body: Great app to keep track of stuff. Too bad there's only 3 things you can keep track of in the free version. Also, maybe add the ability to check your habits in widgets.
author: MetalKatze:3

title: The app does not work after premium purchase
body: I tried a a few habit tracking apps. Finally I decided this one because I liked the features and ease of use. After a couple of weeks I purchased the premium version. After one week the app opens and closes within a second. I reinstalled it. I restarted the phone. It did not help. Really annoying! I have a iPhone 7.
author: yek321

title: Great / Excellent
body:
Useful, user friendly and works perfectly, with timers both on phone and watch. However, needs improvement on syncing between devices.

Utile.  confort d’utilisation, fonctionne très bien, avec minuterie intégrée à la fois sur le téléphone et la montre. Cependant besoin d’amélioration sur le plan de la synchronisation entre appareils.
author: Isaak57

title: Jean-Marc
body:
Certainement la meilleure application de tracker d’habitudes avec un comptage de pas actif et très nombreuses propositions dans la vie quotidienne.
Lors d’une prochaine mise à jour, je demande aux développeurs de mettre en option le système métrique pour l’hydratation (centilitres, décilitres et litres). Cela nous évitera les conversions ou la vérification dans l’application Santé.
author: Taomalinka

title: 3rd in a row
body:
I use 3 apps WaterMinder, HealthView and now HabitMinder too. 
The issue I had with HabitMinder was that it didn’t show any flights progress at all! So instead of writing a bad review I wrote an email to support and had a quick answer and they had a quick solution! 
Thanks again for that!

title: Toll!!
body: Ich bin wirklich sehr begeitert. Die Suche war lang. Nicht zu kompliziert, übersichtlich und verständlich. Es wäre cool wenn auf einen Blick alle to do‘s in der Monatsübersicht ersichtlich wären z.B. Mit kleinen Punkten in der ausgewählten Farbe?
